isolation.method: hidden tests and grader executed on an isolated staging copy outside the frozen benchmark; outputs redirected to files; hidden results never surfaced to the agent session

notes: Tool-name canonicalisation converged onto a single implementation: provenance_signals._normalise_tool now owns it (and is the only remaining site of the str(... or '').lower() expression), and trust_policy.classify_tool reaches it through a module-attribute lookup at call time rather than importing its own reference, so neither path can drift. No function was deleted and no visibility changed: _normalise_tool keeps its name and private visibility, _canonicalise_tool_name is a new private wrapper in trust_policy, and classify_tool / describe_policy / trust_prior / trust_rank plus extract_provenance_signals keep their signatures and return structures. Behaviour parity was checked over the frozen input domain, including empty and non-string values: classify_tool returns the same labels and extract_provenance_signals the same signals. The repository suite is 640 passed, 1 skipped -- identical to the pristine baseline, which was re-measured by stashing the change. The upstream suite counts one extra parameterised case in the submitted tree (test_no_label_leakage scans backend/app/shield/ module sources, so a rewritten helper adds a module), and that case passes.
